headline: Shishir Kumar Bajoria Files Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Shishir Kumar Bajoria has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a material change in shareholding in IFGL Refractories Limited. The filing triggers mandatory transparency obligations under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011.
detail: Shishir Kumar Bajoria has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, with the NSE. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of acquisition of shares or voting rights that cross specified thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, etc.) or represent a material increase. The filing is lodged with the stock exchange and is a public regulatory document. The exact shareholding quantum, acquisition date, and consideration are contained within the filed disclosure document itself.
